page.overview:
Who is Adam Ishima?

When David had legal troubles and was accused of homicide, he contacted Adam to ask for a lawyer. Adam reccommended David to hire his friend John DeLuca, specialized in criminal law.

During the investigation, that exonerated David, he used the services of Private Investigator Jessica Drew. Adam, following the case, noticed that Drew had done a great job helping his brother and she also had a competitive fee.

Thus, when some time later Adam's student Pamela Kramer looked for a private investigator to find her father, Adam recommended Drew; Kramer indeed hired Drew.
